claim: Gotham ward community facts and mitigation offers for the Ratcliffe-on-Soar data centre
quote: Assumed ward-level community facts and mitigation offers used to ground objection responses.

facts.quote: Assumed ~1,850 residents in the Gotham ward catchment used for community briefing.

facts.claim: Share of ward households within 500 m of the site boundary
facts.quote: Assumed 12% of ward households lie within 500 m of the proposed site edge.

facts.claim: Primary school roll within 1 km of the site
facts.quote: Assumed 210 pupils at the nearest primary school within 1 km of the site.

facts.claim: Night-time ambient noise baseline at the nearest homes
facts.quote: Assumed 42 dB night-time baseline at the south-east residential cluster.

offers.claim: Mitigation offer for generator noise at the south-east boundary
offers.quote: Offer: relocate generators to the far north-west edge and fund acoustic fencing along the SE boundary.
offers.offer: Relocate generators to the NW edge and fund acoustic fencing on the SE boundary

offers.claim: Mitigation offer for visual bulk of halls
offers.quote: Offer: pull halls inward and plant a landscape screen so residential sightlines meet a planted edge first.
offers.offer: Pull halls inward and plant a landscape screen on the SE edge

offers.quote: Offer: hold a minimum 400 m generator–home stand-off through every re-plan step.
offers.offer: Hold a minimum 400 m generator–home stand-off across re-plans

offers.quote: Offer: keep both halls and the substation on site so the 180 MW IT load is unchanged.
offers.offer: Keep halls and substation on site so the 180 MW IT load is unchanged
